lead.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia's CEO; CFO Colette Kress steps in
lead.summary: Nvidia's board accepted Huang's resignation as president, CEO and director on 11 November, effective immediately, after reports of an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. Kress, CFO since 2013, becomes interim CEO and stays CFO while the board searches inside and outside the company. Longtime director Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's first-ever board chair. The company says operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap continue without interruption.

number_of_day.label: AWS API models the agent-built AWS Emulator started from: an empty server that answered all of them and did nothing, until agent teams filled it in.

news.headline: A global Microsoft 365 outage takes down Outlook, Teams and Copilot
news.summary: Microsoft says a process that sets up secure connections got overwhelmed on affected servers, so they stopped processing requests; it is looking at recent configuration changes and sees no sign of an attack. Recovery is gradual as servers return and traffic is rerouted. Some users also lost access to other services because their two-factor codes arrive by email.

news.headline: AWS ships a free local emulator of AWS, written entirely by agents
news.summary: AWS Emulator runs on your laptop or in CI, and the AWS CLI, SDKs and coding agents talk to it over a local endpoint with the same APIs and errors as the cloud. It is written in Rust, keeps state in memory, and gives each copy its own port and keys. Agent teams write fidelity tests against real AWS, find gaps and fix them; AWS says no human wrote or reviewed the code. Source is on GitHub under CC0.

news.headline: Google's Gemini Decisions API answers up to 1,000 questions in one pass, with no output tokens
news.summary: The new Gemini Decision 1 model scores yes/no, multiple-choice and rubric questions over one shared input (text, images, audio, video or PDF) and returns probabilities and confidence scores in 150–250 ms. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens, aimed at the small branching calls inside agents: routing, tool choice and policy checks.

news.headline: Nonprofits sue five AI labs to freeze development of advanced models
news.summary: Public Citizen, Heat Initiative, the Alliance for Secure AI and Irreplaceable Education Fund filed in San Francisco Superior Court against Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI and SpaceXSI under California's unfair-competition law, alleging the labs can't stop their models from enabling bioweapons, cyberattacks or loss of control.

writers_corner.title: Place, Personhood, and the Hippocampus
writers_corner.take: Walking her childhood mountain paths again, Popova reads M.R. O'Connor's Wayfinding to ask how the places we learn to navigate end up shaping memory and who we become.
writers_corner.quote: astonished too at how effortlessly I navigate these routes I have not walked in decades.
